name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Klára Dobrev
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided not to lift the legal immunity of Klára Dobrev, a Hungarian member. A Hungarian court asked Parliament to allow criminal proceedings against her over a statement she made at a press conference in 2023. A former government minister brought a private defamation case against her. Parliament judged that the case looks politically motivated and aimed at damaging her work as an elected member, so it refused the request.

- No change: Dobrev keeps her immunity, so the Hungarian criminal case cannot go ahead for now.
- It affects Dobrev, the Hungarian court and the private complainant, a former minister.
- Parliament tells the Hungarian authorities and Dobrev of its decision.
